headline: See the full song set while browsing worship videos.
highlights: Videos show every song from the matching approved set, in set order.
Use the Show sets toggle beside Add Video to show or hide song lists.
On mobile, showing sets uses one column for readable song lists; hiding sets restores two columns.
Search videos by song title, and see song artists and keys in the video player.
Choose the matching service when more than one approved set shares a recording date.
